explanation: Public displays of affection such as holding hands or a quick kiss are generally accepted across Western Europe, including the UK, and most Britons won't react to mild affection. However, British social norms favor reserve and understatement, so prolonged kissing or very visible affection in public can make bystanders uncomfortable.
local_tip: Keep physical affection brief and low-key in public - holding hands or a quick kiss is fine, but save anything more passionate for private.

also_check.note: Cheek-kissing as a greeting and moderate PDA are culturally normal and common in public.
Public affection between unmarried couples is against the law and can lead to arrest.
PDA is uncommon and even hand-holding can draw attention in many social contexts.
